title: When payload encryption is enabled, failure messages and stack traces that temporal-proxy is configured to keep from…
description: A vulnerability in temporal-proxy versions 0.9.0 through 1.2.0 allows failure messages and stack traces to be exposed in plaintext when payload encryption is enabled. This occurs because the proxy decrypts failure attributes and forwards the plaintext messages to the upstream Temporal service, which stores them alongside encrypted copies. The issue affects deployments with failure encryption enabled in the proxy or where the SDK encodes failure attributes. Fixed versions are 1.0.2, 1.1.2, and 1.2.1.
